business_problem: Grainger, a leading North American distributor specializing in maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) supplies, manages a massive inventory of 2.5 million products that serve over one million customers. Grainger’s customer service team faced challenges in rapidly retrieving product information from their large catalog to support their high-traffic e-commerce website.
solution_summary: Grainger built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Databricks Data + AI Platform, AI Search, Databricks Model Serving. Grainger, a leading North American distributor specializing in maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) supplies, manages a massive inventory of 2.5 million products that serve over one million customers. Grainger’s customer service team faced challenges in rapidly retrieving product information from their large catalog to support their high-traffic e-commerce website. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. AI Search indexes enterprise data for semantic retrieval and RAG-style search experiences. Databricks Model Serving hosts production model endpoints or LLM interfaces used by applications and business users.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in shared lakehouse tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and served through analytics, semantic search, or model endpoints for downstream users and applications. It connects with API.
